messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager → HIGH error rate and elevated 5xxs for tenant 'Echelon' on dedicated pool-e2 (us-west-2). Alert rule: pool.requests.90p = 8k rps, sustained errors. Join bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-7056543210
matt-oncall: taking this, joining bridge now.
sam-sre: on bridge. quick triage: noisy tenant detected (tenant-ech-9), top connection spike. starting throttling on tenant.
tina-eng: rolling a traffic split to fallback model-quantized-1 (10% -> 50%) to reduce GPU memory pressure. watching metrics.
jess-cs: cs note — Echelon has been pinging support about timeouts. need ETA for a customer update.
olivia-ops: tagging for customer comms and credits. capture exact windows and requests affected.
raj-product: need a 3-bullet exec summary: scope, root cause hypothesis, mitigation + next steps.
kai-legal: flag — check Echelon contract SLO and credit caps before committing to anything externally.
matt-oncall: timeline so far: 14:02 UTC — throttled tenant-ech-9, 14:07 — traffic split applied, 14:15 — eviction ran, 14:18 — error rate back to baseline. I'll consolidate.
deploy-bot: deploy 78ac34 promoted at 14:07 (traffic-split-change) by tina-eng.
sam-sre: log excerpt for RCA appendix:
```
[14:02:12] pool-e2: conn=435 err_rate=12.4% top_tenant=tenant-ech-9
[14:07:21] pool-e2: throttles=1 eviction=queued
[14:15:03] pool-e2: eviction=success errors=1.8% latency_p50=80ms
```
jess-cs: assigning customer comm draft to olivia-ops, cc matt-oncall. Need clear timeline, impact, and recommended customer actions.
olivia-ops: draft in progress — will include: what happened, what we did, recommended SRE steps for Echelon, and preliminary credit range. Draft aim: EOD.
raj-product: also want a short technical appendix for their SREs: isolation commands, config snippet, and suggested throttle thresholds.
tina-eng: appendix snippet (internal):
```
# isolation (internal only)
redwoodctl tenant isolate --pool pool-e2 --tenant tenant-ech-9
redwoodctl evict --pool pool-e2 --tenant tenant-ech-9 --force
# recommended throttling thresholds
redwoodctl threshold set --pool pool-e2 --tenant tenant-ech-9 --errors 5% --rps 2000
```
matt-oncall: owner assignments:
 - RCA draft: sam-sre
 - Exec summary: raj-product
 - Customer comm: olivia-ops
 - Billing/credits calc: jess-cs (finance)
sam-sre: RCA first pass targeted by tomorrow 11:00 UTC. It will include timeline, root cause (suspected noisy tenant + model cache eviction thrash), mitigations, and engineering action items.
ok-react: :thumbsup:
matt-oncall: proposing post-incident follow-ups: tailored credit proposal, a one-hour workshop with Echelon SREs on isolation/playbooks, and adding stricter tenant throttling defaults.
jess-cs: noted — I'll prepare credit options (contract cap, pro-rata calculations) and the invite template.
olivia-ops: will hold draft until legal confirms wording. planning a "What we did" + "What you can do" structure.
kai-legal: OK to propose credits up to the contract cap; anything larger needs legal + sales approval.
matt-oncall: closing bridge in 30m unless new blockers. After RCA and credit calc, I'll post the customer-facing summary and loop in account exec. Thanks all.
